comment: Manual read at https://flagaudio.com/vcv/oppressor.html, which describes the band splitting and nothing else. No source is published and the panel prints only SENSE, RANGE, A and R, so the SENSE and RANGE lines give the ordinary meanings of those controls on a ducker without a range or a threshold, which no source states. The module browser calls it a ducker and compressor; the manual calls it a multiband ducker, and the entry follows the manual.
